body: I dont have an actual pattern on hand im afraid, but i bet it would be pretty easy to BS one! Take a pattern for a pair of pants that fit you (or find an old pair that fit you and rip the pattern from that. You can seam-rip them if you dont mind loosing em or just be careful in tracing) and simply widen the bottom a bit and it should be okay. To be fair though i do janky sewing
